name: ta.macd
notes: macdLine = ema(fast) - ema(slow); signalLine = ema(macdLine, signal); histLine = macdLine - signalLine. Corrected ta.ema warm-up (SMA seed, na until the length-th valid bar; see docs/ECOSYSTEM.md): ema(close,2) seeds at bar 1, ema(close,4) at bar 3, so macdLine is defined from bar 3; the signal EMA needs two valid macd values and seeds at bar 4.
